lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits. These spots are arranged in approximately five horizontal rows within the visible field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a structured grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity (top) to shadow (bottom).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) visible on the ventral-lateral surface, with one prominently positioned posterior to the pectoral fin.
